en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Is’haq, from Sa’dan, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘It is befitting for the neighbour of the bereaved that he should feed him the food for three days’.
en.sarwar: 3. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ahmad ibn Ishaq from Sa‘dan from abu Basir who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
neighbors of the people of a deceased should prepare food for them (people of the deceased) for three days.”
